quests.sentenceWithBlank: Ice floats on water ____ it is less dense than the liquid form.
quests.completedSentence: Ice floats on water because it is less dense than the liquid form.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Because' gives the reason ice floats - its lower density. 'So' would reverse the logic, making the floating the cause of the lower density.
quests.nativeTip: This explains a basic scientific fact about density, not an outcome or a comparison.
quests.example: Ice floats on water because it is less dense than the liquid form.

quests.nativeTip: The gaps in the tracks are a direct engineering response to the expansion, not an explanation of why metal expands.
quests.example: Metal expands when heated, so engineers leave small gaps between railway tracks.

quests.example: whereas the first experiment used room-temperature water, the second trial tested the same reaction at near-freezing temperatures.
